the_distinction_that_reshapes_the_job.quote: architecture erosion differs from drift; while DRIFT IS A DOCUMENTATION ACCURACY PROBLEM, EROSION IS THE ACTUAL DEGRADATION
the_distinction_that_reshapes_the_job.erosion: the ruling is current and the build broke it -- a BUILD defect, which is what the job assumes
the_distinction_that_reshapes_the_job.drift: the build moved on and the document did not -- a DOCUMENT defect, and the build may be the more current truth
the_distinction_that_reshapes_the_job.consequence: every contradiction must report WHICH SIDE IS NEWER. reporting them all as 'the build ignored him' would put a documentation defect on a lane's record and would tell him his rulings are ignored when some were superseded by his own later words.
